question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Investment
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Investment"** means the action or process of putting money into financial schemes, shares, property, or a commercial venture with the expectation of achieving a profit. (निवेश)

 
 
• **Example: **He made a significant **investment** in the stock market.
 
 
 
• **"Divestment"** refers to the action of selling off subsidiary business interests or investments. (विस्र्जन)
 
 
• **Example: **The company announced the **divestment **of its non-core assets.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Investment'** is **'Divestment'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Outline **(रूपरेखा): A general description or plan showing the essential features of something but without the detail.

 
 
• **Example:** The professor provided an **outline** of the course at the beginning of the semester.
 
 
 
• **Endowment **(दान): A form of donation to a non-profit organization in the form of funds or property.
 
 
• **Example: **The university received a large** endowment **to fund its research programs.
 
 
 
• **Goody** (मिठाई): An attractive or desirable item, especially one that is small and given as a gift.
 
 
• **Example:** The children received a bag of **goodies** at the party.
